title: Manually mount a file system to a directory
summary: Attach a file system from a device (like a partition or USB drive) to a specific directory so you can access its files.
prerequisites: The target directory exists and is empty (or you accept hiding its current contents).

steps.explain: Mount the file system from the device to the chosen directory.

placeholders.name: MOUNT_POINT
placeholders.description: The directory to mount to, e.g., /mnt

verify.expect: Output shows the device mounted at the specified directory.

placeholders.name: MOUNT_POINT
placeholders.description: The directory where the file system is mounted

warnings: Mounting over a non-empty directory hides its existing contents until unmounted.
